title: feat(service-automation)!: two packages of two namespaces may each declare a connector of the same name (ADR-0150 child B, the narrowing)
body:
domain:server#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzKCovWpJoMZD6U3NT

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao3aDjoEUznHeGMZJaoMEKa5)_
Fixes #31699

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: added

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：连接器（#31699 的最后一个类型）把「一个名字一个包」收窄到「一个命名空间一个」。两个不同命名空间的包可以各自声明同名连接器，各自物化、连接、派发。
- 怎么做到的：connector 加入 core / objectql / metadata 三个命名空间类型集合；协调器拆掉一持有者兜底，物化器的各个表和 OAuth 授权句柄按 (包, 名) 建键；引擎对每个调用方（包括无包的调用方）都问解析器，解析到的持有者没有实例时回答 `none`，只有插件代码注册的连接器例外；拉取按映射所在的包解析连接器；带命名空间地址的连接门（`/automation/connectors/:ns/:name/connection`）连接该命名空间那个包的实例。
- 仍然拒绝：同一命名空间的共有者、没有命名空间的包与他包同名、一个包内重名、两个持有者下没有自己包戳的条目（点名两个持有者，谁都不物化）。没有包作用域注册表的组合仍然一个名字一个实例。
- 答复变化：changeset 的 Clause-② 列了十条 FROM → TO，标为 BREAKING。单持有者部署只变三处：3b 的回退分支（解析到的包没有实例时不再用名字的唯一实例，插件代码注册的除外）、只有停用包持有的名字（停用包以外的调用方不再派发；停用包自己的流程照旧读自己的实例）、无包戳条目换持有者后到下次协调之间不派发。凭据列表、重载合并、惰性描述符审计在单持有者下都与 main 相同。
- 与交接清单的偏差：交接 6871869590 写的是裸连接门和 `GET /connectors` 加 `?package=`。本 PR 用已有的命名空间地址代替第二种写法，`GET /connectors` 不加过滤，每个描述符带 `packageId`。认领修订 6882996364 事先说明了这一点。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts`（`resolveConnectorInstanceFor`）、`src/plugin.ts`（协调器的期望集合与 `judgedByPackage`、`connectionDoorSubject`）、`src/connector-pull.ts`（第 2 步）、`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts`（准入块）。

## What changes

- **Type sets.** `connector` joins `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` (core), `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` (objectql) and `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` (metadata). Every covered type has now narrowed.
- **Reconcile** (`plugin.ts`):
  - The backstop is gone (`refusedDeclaredConnectorNames`, and `refusedConnectorNames` in `connector-package-scope.ts`).
  - Each entry is the instance of its own package. An entry with no package of its own is the instance of the package its name resolves to over every holder. Under two holders it is refused naming both and materialized as neither (`connectorInstanceRefusal`).
  - `desired`, the materialized, degraded and credential-refusal maps, retry, dematerialize and `grantHandles` are keyed by instance (`connectorInstanceKey`: `name`, or `PACKAGE/NAME`).
  - A name repeated within one package is a duplicate naming the package. A composition with no package-scoped registry keeps one instance per name (`judgedByPackage`, red line 1).
  - A reloaded artifact (#7742) supersedes the registry's entries by `(package, name)`: an unstamped artifact item is stamped with its manifest id at capture, so a reload of one package leaves the other package's instance of the name live. With no manifest id, or no package-scoped registry, it supersedes by name, as before.
  - An OAuth2 grant handle reads its instance's fixed package. The inert-descriptor audit judges each entry by the instance a caller of its package would be served. Instance log lines name the package.
- **Dispatch** (`engine.ts`, `resolveConnectorInstanceFor`):
  - Every caller asks the resolver over the served holders, a caller with no package included, so a two-holder name is refused naming both rather than answered `none`.
  - A resolved holder with no instance answers `none`, unless the name has a connector a plugin registers in code (package `null`, origin `plugin`), which is served as before. That keeps a package's catalog descriptor plus a plugin's connector working.
  - A name only disabled packages hold answers the same way (notes 6816295828 and 6820178514).
  - `getConnectorDescriptors` sets `packageId`.
- **Pull** (`connector-pull.ts`): the mapping's connector is resolved from the mapping's holder package through the registry's optional `resolveConnectorInstanceFor`, and its origin, degraded state, provider (`materializedProviderOf`), action and `inputSchema` are read from that instance. New reason `connector_name_refused` (409).
- **Connection door**: `ConnectorConnectionRequest.package` (spec, optional). The runtime admits a namespace address of a two-holder connector name to the addressed holder (`admitAutomationAddress` answers a slot, as for a flow) and passes the package. The bare door keeps its 409.
- **Credential listing**: each declaring entry is matched to its own instance's state, by the instance's package (an environment row or a compatibility entry is its holder's instance); the reported `packageId` is the entry's stamp, as on main.
- **#33218 review N6**: judged, not restamped. A row a moved declaration left stamped with its old package is that package's own again once it declares the name beside the new holder. Pinned.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` gains "Two packages, one connector name" and two failure-mode rows. The objectql, core and metadata module docs say the connector narrowed.

## Verification

- New pins:
  - `connector-connection-door.test.ts` (7): both instances materialize; the bare door 409 and the addressed begin, read and revoke per package, each with its own row and token; revoke one, the other keeps serving; an unowned entry under two holders refused; a duplicate within a package; the no-registry CONTROL; N6.
  - `flow-package-scoped-resolution.test.ts`: the narrowing `none` pin (FROM the fallback arm); the plugin catalog CONTROL; the disabled holder in both registration orders (A's caller never served B's or A's instance; a caller with no package served B; CONTROL both enabled) and a lone disabled holder; the null caller refused naming both; the no-registry CONTROL.
  - `connector-pull.test.ts` (4) and `connector-pull-service-door.test.ts` (1): each package's mapping pulls its own instance; the provider read per instance; holder with no instance is `connector_not_registered`; an environment mapping over two holders is `409 connector_name_refused`.
  - `connector-materialization.test.ts`: two holders of different namespaces both materialize (FROM the boot refused); a reload of one holder's artifact leaves the other's instance live; the credential listing reports each of two instances' states, and a `sys_metadata` or `__runtime__` entry over a one-holder name reads the holder's state.
  - `connector-connection-door.test.ts` (review round): a disabled holder at the bare door and at its own namespace address (404, nothing written), both orders; a revoked instance is held degraded; the unstamped entry's handle reads its fixed package.
  - `flow-package-scoped-resolution.test.ts` (review round): a caller inside the disabled package reads its own instance (both orders, and alone); two catalog holders beside a plugin connector (each package served the plugin's, the null caller refused naming both).
  - `connector-pull.test.ts` (review round): one of two holders disabled, the environment's mapping pulls through the served holder.
  - `connector-descriptor-audit.test.ts`: a package's catalog entry is not silenced by another package's live instance of its name.
  - runtime `automation-addressed-route.test.ts`: each namespace address reads its own package's instance (FROM 409).
  - `marketplace-install-local-bare-name-conflict.test.ts`: the refusal case is now a same-namespace co-owner; a cross-namespace connector install is admitted (FROM 422).
- Updated pins: the one-holder type-set pins in core, objectql and metadata; the CLI stored-references report (no sealed clash left).
- Ablations A1 to A14 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored with an empty `git diff HEAD`), each red on its pins: the fallback arm back (3), the disabled branch off (1), the null caller not asking the resolver (8), no plugin instance (1), the unowned entry not refused (1), no registry judged (6), grant handles by name (5), the pull by bare name (4), the door ignoring the package (3), the provider by name (1), no connector slot at the runtime address (1); the reload merge by bare name (1, A12); the credential listing by stamp (1, A13); the inert audit by name (1, A14). Record: `server-seat-7/r2026-11-14/31699-narrow-ablations.txt`.
- Full suites before the rebase: service-automation 3923, core 3480, objectql 12967, metadata 2479, metadata-protocol 22848 (43 skipped), cloud-connection 1207. After the rebase on `df9fe946`: service-automation 3941, runtime 12060 (19 skipped), core 3480, objectql 12976, metadata 2479, metadata-protocol 22848 (43 skipped), cloud-connection 1210, CLI stored-references 13. All passed. Rebased again on `4ace1fa9` over #33193 (head `1530146d`): metadata 2490, metadata-protocol 22865 (43 skipped), service-automation 3941, runtime 12074 (19 skipped), spec 28422 (1 todo), spec `check:generated` green.
- Gates: `tsc --noEmit` (service-automation, runtime), ESLint on every changed file, tenant-audit, system-context, route-ledger and engine-double censuses, changeset no-major / empty / fixed, doc-authoring, doc-anchors, spec `check:generated` (its test-typecheck leg needs a larger Node heap here: `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=12288`; then OK, no debt moved). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 124 derived families accounted for, 122 run green, 2 NOT-MEASURED for prerequisites this checkout lacks and the diff does not touch: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (no `studio` / `embedder-openai` dist) and the `check-plugin-teardown-shape` self-test (shallow clone). `check:dts-closure` was red once in the sweep and green when re-run alone (311/311 declaration files present).

## Contract review

An isolated contract reviewer read the card, ADR-0150, the handoff and the diff with no anchor on mine.

- r1 on `4a9d32b9`: PASS-WITH-CHANGES. Two must-fix items: M1, the credential listing lost an environment row's state; M2, a reload of one package's artifact tore down the other package's instance. Five should-fix items (S1 to S5) and four nits.
- Every item was taken: fixed in code (M1, M2, the nits), or declared in the changeset and docs with FROM and TO (S1 to S4), with pins for S5. The ablations were extended to A12 to A14.
- delta-1 on `de90aedb`: PASS. Three notes; I acted on all three: no-registry reloads supersede by name as on main, a changeset clause, and a `__runtime__` pin.
- delta-2 on `510a8400`: PASS.
- delta-3 on `e467615b`, the rebase over #33193: PASS. `connector` joins `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_METADATA_TYPES` (`@objectstack/spec`), the one list the history and rollback doors and the metadata store read; the changeset says what moves on those doors.

The brief, the r1 record and the delta record are posted as comments on this PR.

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: `check:generated` is green for its artifacts.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
